description: This file implements functions related to handling 'resolve undo' information in a version control system, likely Git. It includes functions for recording, serializing, deserializing, clearing, and applying resolve undo data within the index state, facilitating undo operations on merge resolutions.

methods.name: void record_resolve_undo(struct index_state * istate,struct cache_entry * ce)
methods.description: Records resolve-undo information for a specific cache entry within the index state, storing object IDs and modes per stage.

methods.name: void resolve_undo_write(struct strbuf * sb,struct string_list * resolve_undo,const struct git_hash_algo * algop)
methods.description: Serializes the resolve-undo information into a string buffer, using a specified hash algorithm.

methods.name: struct:string_list * resolve_undo_read(const char * data,unsigned long size,const struct git_hash_algo * algop)
methods.description: Deserializes resolve-undo data from a buffer into a string list, reconstructing undo information.

methods.name: void resolve_undo_clear_index(struct index_state * istate)
methods.description: Clears and frees the resolve-undo data associated with the index state.

methods.name: int unmerge_index_entry(struct index_state * istate,const char * path,struct resolve_undo_info * ru,unsigned ce_flags)
methods.description: Converts a merged cache entry into an unmerged state based on resolve-undo info, replacing the index entry.

methods.name: void unmerge_index(struct index_state * istate,const struct pathspec * pathspec,unsigned ce_flags)
methods.description: Iterates over resolve-undo entries and applies unmerge operations to index entries that match a given pathspec.
